107411158881912.title: Wyrmling
107411158881912.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Clad in bronze scales that shimmer like sunlit armor, the Wyrmling is the ember-born offspring of a militant legacy. Though small in stature, it carries the spirit of an ancient fire, coiled tight within a frame still learning its place in the skies. Its breath is smoke and promise, its eyes twin coals that burn with challenge and curiosity. Tempered by flame and ferocity, it yields to no hand that has not earned its trust through trial. Once bound, however, its loyalty is fierce and unshakable, a bond forged not by dominance, but by mutual will. The Mayor of Halcyon holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

107450369136250.title: Skinwalker
more: Skinwalkers are undead canine horrors, stitched and shaped through forbidden magic. Created by the necromancers of the self-proclaimed God Emperor Atrax during the Great War of the Undying, they were bred to track, chase, and tear apart the living without pause. Their ragged hides shift like shadowed mist, giving them their name, and their glowing eyes never blink. Though monstrous, some warlocks and death-worshipping cults have managed to ride them, using their unnatural speed and resilience to terrify enemies and storm the battlefield like hounds of the void.

108639528703612.title: Verdant Voyager

Aquatic Mount
Level 25

130% Ground Speed
190% Water Speed
Underwater Breathing
more: Built for the mire and made to last, the Verdant Voyager is a swamp sled drawn by a hulking crocodilian beast. Its moss-covered hull glides across mud and tangled roots as if born to it, while the beast that pulls it lumbers forward with unstoppable force. Carved from ancient timber and reinforced through ritual, the sled endures where others sink. In lands where footfalls vanish and trails twist, this mount carries its rider with grim reliability.

6064629326071791617.title: Thundering Bolt Beast
6064629326071791617.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
1000% Maximum Health
more: Born from the breath of tempests and the wrath of shattered skies, the Thundering Bolt Beast is lightning made flesh, a force of nature bound only by will and woven legend. Its body pulses with crackling veins of raw energy, each thunderous step splitting the air and searing the ground with arcs of stormfire. Where it walks, the wind bows and the earth remembers. Tales whisper of an age when the heavens waged war upon themselves and flocks of Bolt Beasts circled the maelstroms like living sigils of judgment, their cries echoing across creation. Though their kind has all but vanished into the clouds that birthed them, the fiercest storms still call to them, and one has answered to Windansea. The Mayor alone rides this elemental fury, chosen not by conquest, but by the storm's own recognition of a soul forged in chaos and crowned in command.

6064631007499452456.description: An age-worn blade of Aelan origin, forged with a balance most uncommon. Though long of form, the sword is cumbersome to wield, its hilt marred by time's cruel hand. 6064631113630089216.title: Wrath's Legacy
6064631113630089216.description: A colossal two-handed weapon steeped in ancient fury and retribution. It is not merely swung, but unleashed--a testament to the burdens of ancestral anger and the promise of irrevocable judgment.

6064631121001119755.title: Wyrmling
6064631121001119755.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Clad in bronze scales that shimmer like sunlit armor, the Wyrmling is the ember-born offspring of a militant legacy. Though small in stature, it carries the spirit of an ancient fire, coiled tight within a frame still learning its place in the skies. Its breath is smoke and promise, its eyes twin coals that burn with challenge and curiosity. Tempered by flame and ferocity, it yields to no hand that has not earned its trust through trial. Once bound, however, its loyalty is fierce and unshakable, a bond forged not by dominance, but by mutual will. The Mayor of Halcyon holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

6064631121029234713.title: Flailrunner
more: Clad in scales and crowned with a crest of hardened spines, the Flailrunner is a creature born from the primeval wilds and shaped by centuries of predation and power. Its eyes gleam with unsettling clarity, ever watchful, ever calculating. When threatened, it unfurls a luminous dewlap from its throat, a blazing disc of color that ripples with menace and warning. This vibrant display is no idle flourish, but the prelude to an eruption of speed and fury, as the beast hurls itself into motion with breathtaking aggression. Despite its formidable size, the Flailrunner is astonishingly agile, clambering up cliffsides, leaping between branches, and diving into water with the grace of a creature half its mass. Hunters revere them, warriors trust them, and only the fearless ever attempt to ride one. In the saddle of a Flailrunner, there is no stillness, only movement, tension, and the raw pulse of the ancient world.

6064631121034936346.title: Scalerunner

6064631121070653483.title: Eagle Gryphon
6064631121070653483.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Cloaked in wind and crowned in sunlight, the Eagle Gryphon reigns over the skies with a presence both regal and unrelenting. Its wings span like the banners of forgotten empires, each feather sharp with purpose and etched with the memory of high places. The lion's strength coils beneath its taloned grace, and its cry carries like a trumpet over stone and treetop. Forged in the thin air of ancient mountain thrones, the Eagle Gryphon is a creature of clarity and command, drawn to those who rule not with secrecy but with vision cast wide and true. It serves the Mayor of Winstead alone, recognizing in them the soul of a leader who does not follow the path but charts it.

6064631121090052147.title: Pridestrider
6064631121090052147.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: The Pridestrider moves with the solemn grace of a living myth, a mount woven from the breath of storms and the silence of sacred groves. Its head bears the visage of a white lion, regal and unyielding, crowned with a pair of straight, gleaming horns that rise like spears of moonstone toward the heavens. The torso is that of a great gorilla, heavy with primal strength and steady as a mountain?s heart. Its wings, vast and fragile in appearance, unfold in shimmering layers like the breath of a butterfly caught between worlds, scattering iridescent light with each beat. The Pridestrider does not gallop or glide but commands the air with the authority of a sovereign spirit. It answers only to the Mayor of Miraleth, whose dominion must hold the weight of law and the lightness of vision in equal measure.

6064632745387294744.description: Old Dunzen forging techniques were the greatest in recorded history. To recover even a mundane piece made during the height of their forgecraft is a windfall for any adventurer.

6064632746422042631.title: Glittering Metal Strand
6064632746422042631.description: A short length of flexible metal wire infused with the essence of those that opposed the Toren Empire's mad reign. The accursed process that led to its creation has been lost to time.

6064632746553573388.title: The Brace of Balm
6064632746553573388.description: In life, the healer Pelomneh specialized in treating burns and callouses, bolstered by her enchanted gloves. After the Toren captured Braithreach, it was difficult for her to find time for a break.

6064632750916501504.title: Forgeguard's Harness
more: This messy web of straps and belting could be arranged to secure forged plates.

6064632750917550085.title: Eucidiaeh's Hammer Head

more: The pitted head of Master Smith Eucidiaeh's hammer. Could be repurposed by a skilled weaponsmith.

6064632775609221157.title: Key to the Honorsworn
6064632775609221157.description: A silver crystal gem rests in the flat of the key. A tag, dangling from the end reads: 'Make your answers known: Allow the Lightcatcher to Drink Deep in the Flames.

sources.name: The key's crystal gem begins to turn color in the fire. After a few seconds, it settles into a glowing silver hue.

6064632780401675743.description: This self-fertilizing root ball will grow a strong ash tree when planted in a freehold.

6064632780410781696.title: Permanent Ink
more: A potent alchemical creation, this ink is imbued with enduring properties, ensuring siege declarations are etched permanently into history. Crafted by skilled alchemists, it is an essential tool for marking the dawn of conquest.

6064632780417011169.title: Western Larch Rooting Ball
6064632780417011169.description: This self-fertilizing root ball will grow a strong western larch tree when planted in a freehold.

6064632937180430348.title: Glimmering Geode Beast Of Burden
6064632937180430348.description: A fine beast trained to pull caravans.

6064632983233036291.title: Guild: Seal of Valor
6064632983233036291.description: A seal of valor awarded to guilds who have performed graciously for the people of Sanctus settling in Verra. This can be consumed to earn guild xp.

6064632983375380501.title: Calcified Eyestalk
6064632983375380501.description: Scarred and bruised, this Ocular is like no other within the sepulcher. The scars and twists in its still-twitching stalk indicate it had survived something more grotesque than itself.

6064632983875092611.title: Djinn's Enchanted Metal
more: An otherworldly alloy infused with the magic of the sands. It hums softly when touched, resisting any attempt to shape it by mundane means.

6064632988571926530.title: Archetype Scroll: Tank
6064632988571926530.description: Changes your primary archetype to tank.

6064632988572516358.title: Archetype Scroll: Summoner
6064632988572516358.description: Changes your primary archetype to summoner.

6064632989081797368.title: Scroll of Experience: Level 25 Artisanship: Weaponsmithing

6064632994650128423.title: Agave Syrup
6064632994650128423.description: This golden, viscous syrup is harvested from the enchanted agave plants of the sandsquall desert. Sweet with a faint floral undertone, it holds subtle restorative properties.

6064633011239976961.title: Recipe: Obsidian Necklace
6064633011239976961.description: Apprentice Jeweler recipe for Obsidian Necklace.

6064633061768691718.title: Scorpion
6064633061768691718.description:
Gather: Sandsquall Desert 
Ingredient In: Animal Husbandry

6064633067485265938.title: Recipe: Regalia Of Conquest Feet
6064633067485265938.description: Journeyman Leatherworking recipe for Regalia Of Conquest Feet.

6064633135463727184.title: Croctooth Charm
6064633135463727184.description: Oswolt the Stoat led the first Dunestrider crew across the Sandsquall. For each crocodile they defeated, he added a tooth to his necklace. Eventually, he stopped wearing them, though, as the clattering charms gave him away while stalking the oasis pools.

6064633135978381393.title: Croc Leather Scraps
6064633135978381393.description:
Drop: Leathermaw 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking, Jeweler
more: The hoary elder crocodiles of the Sandsquall's oases ate more than a dozen newly minted Dunestriders before the mercenaries learned that decoys of date-palm wood, soaked in cow's blood from Riverlands herds, would lure the crocs from their ponds onto the open sand, where they could be more readily dealt with.

6064633135978971218.title: Sungazer Stones
6064633135978971218.description:
Drop: Sungazer Murgo 
Ingredient In: Armorsmithing
more: These colorful, fist sized chunks of variegated stone are hand-polished into faceted geometric shapes, scholars of the giants resident in the Sandsquall are unsure if the crude baubles are used for gaming, religious practice, or simple aesthetics.

6064633254046007300.title: Coconut
6064633254046007300.description:
Gather: Turquoise Sea, Jundark 
Ingredient In: Farming

6064633267284410371.title: Telsaula Stinger
6064633267284410371.description: The terminating segment of the tail of a giant desert scorpid comprises this monstrous relic. Over a yard long, this desiccated spine yet drips an endless trickle of caustic venom. It is ever warm to the touch, and emits a not-entirely-unpleasant scent of sand and sweet, sickly, rot.

6064633267293650949.title: Eskra Owl
6064633267293650949.description: This statue of a stately owl stands just over a meter high. It is carved from a single piece of Eskra Crystal, and bears a tranquil countenance whose gaze transmits wisdom and tranquility. Its feathers, meticulously crafted and polished, shimmer and refract the ambient light. The craftwork is sublime.

6064633272385667078.title: Thornstride Stonebond Twin Daggers
6064633272385667078.description: The edge carries a tempered gleam, as if fresh from the final pass of the stone.

6064633289013002273.title: Slate Binding
6064633289013002273.description: The front and back cover of what used to be a large book, made of hard, fire-scarred slate. Unfortunately, the pages have all been burned away.

6064633289612656776.title: Varek's Silk Slippers
6064633289612656776.description: Varek "The Raven" commanded his Desertfrost followers into the depths below the sinkhole. His followers took the pact with him, and they reemerged among the undead.

6064633419687002126.title: Apprentice Tempering Kit - Weapon
6064633419687002126.description:
A small, sturdy wooden box, polished to a soft sheen. Inside, nestled in compartments lined with dark velvet, are collected the required elements of magical enchantment. The lid is adorned with a small emblem, signifying the type of gear the kit is designed to enhance.
This kit can only be used on equipment of equal or lesser grade than itself; attempts to temper higher-tier gear are magically inhibited and cannot even be initiated.

6064633605990580226.title: Pridestrider
6064633605990580226.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: The Pridestrider moves with the solemn grace of a living myth, a mount woven from the breath of storms and the silence of sacred groves. Its head bears the visage of a white lion, regal and unyielding, crowned with a pair of straight, gleaming horns that rise like spears of moonstone toward the heavens. The torso is that of a great gorilla, heavy with primal strength and steady as a mountain?s heart. Its wings, vast and fragile in appearance, unfold in shimmering layers like the breath of a butterfly caught between worlds, scattering iridescent light with each beat. The Pridestrider does not gallop or glide but commands the air with the authority of a sovereign spirit. It answers only to the Mayor of Wildport, whose dominion must hold the weight of law and the lightness of vision in equal measure.

6064633652034797608.title: Siege Declaration Banner - Vhalgadim
6064633652034797608.description:
A level 15 or above player can use this banner to declare a siege against Vhalgadim.

Seek out a stone platform near the marketplace of Vhalgadim to place this banner.

6064633696461717514.title: Siege Declaration Banner - Seahook
6064633696461717514.description:
A level 15 or above player can use this banner to declare a siege against Seahook.

Seek out a stone platform near the marketplace of Seahook to place this banner.

6064633702828605440.title: A Magical Bag Of Goodies
6064633702828605440.description: A bag of fun things to select as a reward

6064633730629369948.title: Broken Lantern
6064633730629369948.description: A shattered lantern of Dunir craftsmanship. It's not an ancient relic, but a recent trace left behind by missing settlers.

6064633747115696723.title: Heart of Golgora
6064633747115696723.description: Hidden beneath magma waterfalls and prowling obsidian elementals, the Heart lies sealed in a jagged altar of voidmetal, untouched by heat or time. It feels alien, cold, silent, and wrong. A flawless obsidian prism unleashes the pulsing red core from the surrounding stone, a key that unbinds the relic's celestial prison. Even as it is released, it seems to reject the touch of mortals, as if dragged from a place it was never meant to leave.

6064633786060439562.title: Ramkin Totem
6064633786060439562.description: A thick piece of hardwood has been crudely carved into the image of a ram-beast. Do the Ramkin praise a false god?

6064633860905959428.title: Stonechant Bindings
6064633860905959428.description: Grows warm when deep words are spoken beneath breath.

6064633860906680329.title: Thornway Accord Cloak
6064633860906680329.description: Trails behind as if another walks with you, always just out of sight.

6064633860915921044.title: Cindermarch Bracers
6064633860915921044.description: Guard the forearms with the steady weight of tempered craft, turning aside the blow while keeping the arms swift.

6064633860916248735.title: Brinetread Gloves
6064633860916248735.description: Hold a sure grip through spray and rain, the fingers steady on rope, oar, or hilt.

6064633860916773026.title: Gritmantle Cape
6064633860916773026.description: Hangs in coarse, weighty folds that move only with purpose, its surface etched faintly like stone shaped by wind and time.

6064633860919525595.title: Gloomraider Leggings
6064633860919525595.description: Cut for rapid movement through tangled ground, they give without resistance when the pace turns from stillness to sudden attack.

6064633860920574187.title: Coalhewn Jerkin
6064633860920574187.description: Shaped for balance between defense and freedom, its panels flex with the motion of a steady march or a sudden pivot in the press of battle.

6064633860920574193.title: Coalhewn Belt
6064633860920574193.description: Secures the set with a craftsman's precision, its straps cinched to keep every plate and panel in place when the ground is uneven.

6064633860920901878.title: Tidepiercer Greaves
6064633860920901878.description: Slim but strong, their lower plates flared to shield against the sudden bite of reef and jetty stone.

6064633860921229569.title: Scorchmantle Pauldrons
6064633860921229569.description: High-arched plates angled to deflect the slanting sun, their silhouette giving the wearer the profile of a watchtower on the horizon.

6064633860921491724.title: Duskhunter Belt
6064633860921491724.description: Secures every piece with balanced tension, its fit holding firm through the long hours of a hunt.

6064633860947509551.title: Glenwarden Greaves
6064633860947509551.description: These greaves carry dust from long-abandoned roads. When worn, they muffle the clink of movement with a hush that feels half-earned and half-given.

6064633860948164919.title: Undermarch Vaulthelm
6064633860948164919.description: This domed helm bears a browplate shaped like a closed eye. Within, the padding holds a faint trace of incense, burned in rituals long abandoned.

6064633860949147979.title: Crownbreaker Pauldrons
6064633860949147979.description: Mottled with lichen and scarred by wind, these shoulders bore the weight of unclaimed names. When rivers ran red and silence ruled the woods, they rose with the chant of resistance.

6064633860950917461.title: Luminous Concord Faulds
6064633860950917461.description: Shaped with care and ceremonial weight, these faulds move like draped stone. In their sway, there is a rhythm older than war, echoing with the steadiness of purpose unshaken.

6064633860971561305.title: Stormcanon Bracers
6064633860971561305.description: Braided with the tension of stormline rigging, these bracers bear the memory of soaked ropes and splintered decks. Their grip steadies in crosswinds and does not falter in rain.

6064633860971561307.title: Stormcanon Helmet
6064633860971561307.description: Shaped in the shade of cliffside jungles and tempered by salt and storm, this helm seals the mind in a hush older than speech. Its gaze narrows with the wind and tracks what stirs beyond the breakers.

6064633860983357862.title: Moltruin Girdle
6064633860983357862.description: Locks the armor in place with the same binding force that seals the deep fires until their time comes.

6064633860984275391.title: Graveplate Greaves
6064633860984275391.description: Anchor the stride like the pillars of buried temples, each step driving deep into the ground's damp strength.

6064633860985717200.title: Coralhold Helm
6064633860985717200.description: Shaped to turn aside both steel and fear, it seals the wearer in the cool calm that lies beneath the reach of the waves, where danger is met with unblinking resolve.

6064633860986044890.title: Scaldplate Greaves
6064633860986044890.description: Advance without falter, the weight balanced to keep the stride even whether on packed earth or rolling dune.

6064633860986372580.title: Cryptward Pauldrons
6064633860986372580.description: Shoulder the memory of all who have kept vigil in the Jundark, their silent defiance rising like black stone against the press of the shadows.

6064633860987945468.title: Reefguard Gauntlets
6064633860987945468.description: Close with the certainty of a fisherman's net cast true, a grip unbroken until the task is done.

6064633860989321744.title: Tombplate Greaves
6064633860989321744.description: Stand with the certainty of stone pillars deep in the earth, unmoved by the press of foliage or the weight of silence.

6064633860998300189.title: Thistlemaw Trousers
6064633860998300189.description: Leaves do not stick to them, but will turn as if to watch the wearer pass.

6064633861004132934.title: Ward of the Sevenfold Light Bracers
6064633861004132934.description: Etched with sigils long worn smooth by ritual and use, these bracers once circled the arms of those who bore the burden of vigilance. They glint faintly in dim light, as if reflecting a fire that has not yet gone out.

6064633861004657225.title: Unfallen Rainment Hood
6064633861004657225.description: Drawn low over the brow, this hood bears the hush of deep waters and the hush of stories unspoken. Its threads remember the salt of ancestral crossings and the gaze of stars reflected in tidepools.

6064633861004657233.title: Unfallen Rainment Cape
6064633861004657233.description: The cloth drapes as if still wet from sea mist, holding the hush of early tides and whispered farewells. Worn long enough, its weight begins to vanish, replaced by the sensation of drifting between shores.

6064633861010162331.title: Seafoam Leggings
6064633861010162331.description: Flow easily with each stride, loose enough to catch the breeze while holding close enough for quick movement.

6064633861010162338.title: Seafoam Cape
6064633861010162338.description: Shifts with the easy rhythm of the tide, each fold touched by the pale shimmer of sunlight on moving water.

6064633861010424485.title: Dustwhisper Shoulders
6064633861010424485.description: Lie close against the body, their curve turning aside a strike without catching in the heat of motion.

6064633861012062905.title: Thistledown Jerkin
6064633861012062905.description: Close-fitted and easy in weight, it moves with the body as naturally as the meadow bends before the breeze.

6064633861012521672.title: Mistglean Legs
6064633861012521672.description: Move fluidly with each stride, whether wading the shallows or running the length of a pier.

6064633861012718288.title: Veilsand Hood
6064633861012718288.description: Draws forward to shadow the eyes, muting the glare until the wearer can read the land with ease.

6064633861012718295.title: Veilsand Gloves
6064633861012718295.description: Hold a sure grip in heat and dust alike, the fingers steady even when the air shimmers with the weight of midday.

6064633861230900581.title: Runic Sigil
6064633861230900581.description: A round, flat sigil carved from dusky red stone. On one side, an inscription of a rune is engraved onto the surface.

6064633861365563392.title: Rusty Axe
6064633861365563392.description: A brittle but firm handle with a cleaved head attached with force.  When you must cleave a path on your ways onward, the blade crafted with intent to adventure.

6064633866782179381.title: Driftwrought Earring
6064633866782179381.description: Its surface holds the soft ripple of shorebreak, a pattern that shifts as the light moves. Tilt it once and a faint brine sheen gathers, as if the tide had just receded.

6064633866786046018.title: Hollowbound Earring
6064633866786046018.description: A narrow hoop darkened like stone kept from the sun, etched with lines that resemble sealed doors. When turned, the markings seem to fold inward, as if guarding a secret that will not cross the threshold.

6064633866936189010.title: Stoneforge Hand Axe
6064633866936189010.description: Carved from quarried steel and tempered in hearths built into the cliff-face, the Stoneforge Hand Axe bears the steady weight of ancestral craft. Its edge never chips, only dulls with silence, and old dwarves say it will not strike true unless its bearer knows the shape of their own name.

6064633867061231713.title: Sunfire Axe
6064633867061231713.description: Warm brass-bright tones glint at the socket, a field-day gleam that never turns gaudy under cloud.

6064633867061559394.title: Flameheart Axe
6064633867061559394.description: Warmth lingers in the metal like banked coals, the face faintly marred where slag once kissed and fell away.

6064633867064705134.title: Glassveil Axe
6064633867064705134.description: Edges catch the sun with mirage clarity, a desert shimmer that turns solid a blink after the eye expects air.

6064633867089674376.title: Sunscorch Great Axe
6064633867089674376.description: Flat, glare-taming facets keep the sight clear, even when the horizon swims with heat.

6064633867093934221.title: Mirageborn Great Axe
6064633867093934221.description: Contours waver as if drawn by wind, yet the centerline stays true through the arc.

6064633867095441553.title: Stormcurrent Great Axe
6064633867095441553.description: Lines sweep like a stormfront, the mass trimmed to ride momentum without losing hand on the helm.

6064633867095638162.title: Glassveil Great Axe
6064633867095638162.description: Edges read clear as desert air, a cutting plane that seems to arrive a heartbeat before its shadow.

6064633867113201827.title: Seabright Great Grimoire
6064633867113201827.description: Edge gilding gleams salt bright, spreads breathing like a chart unrolled on a captain's table.

6064633867127029955.title: Nightreaver Twin Daggers
6064633867127029955.description: Blackened steel with river smooth curves, quiet in the hand and colder in the strike.

6064633867127554244.title: Deepweld Twin Daggers
6064633867127554244.description: Hammer true flats and a calm grey polish, the pair sits in the palms with the certainty of stone.

6064633867127947462.title: Glassveil Twin Daggers
6064633867127947462.description: Edges hold a desert clean clarity, the profile rippling like heat over pale stone.

6064633867171987658.title: Stoneforge Focus
6064633867171987658.description: Unyielding and silent, the Stoneforge Focus rests with the stillness of quarried stone. It does not shift, wobble, or roll, no matter the slope beneath it.

6064633867178934490.title: Mirageborn Focus
6064633867178934490.description: Contours waver subtly in the heat shimmer of its pale frame.

6064633867182997731.title: Runeweld Longbow
6064633867182997731.description: Etched with symbols long worn smooth, the Runeweld Longbow thrums faintly when aimed with purpose. Its string tightens or slackens on its own, as if aligning with unseen lines.

6064633867183784165.title: Sandcarved Longbow
6064633867183784165.description: Carved with windswept precision and silent in flight, it was once strung beneath a sky veiled in gold dust.

6064633867188895991.title: Dreadwake Longbow
6064633867188895991.description: Darkened curve and taut string seem to drink the light of passing waters.

6064633867211047186.title: Mistwood Great Mace
6064633867211047186.description: The Mistwood Great Mace carries a subtle give, as if its weight adjusts mid-swing. When held still in deep woods, distant branches creak in rhythm with the breath.

6064633867212292374.title: Thornbound Great Mace
6064633867212292374.description: Bound in the ancient rites of riverward groves, this mace carries the hush of damp roots and forgotten pledges. Its weight feels heavier near still water, as though something beneath listens.

6064633867287855595.title: Stormcurrent Greatsword

6064633895674642469.title: Mount Cosmetic: Arctic Prowler
6064633895674642469.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your flying mount.
more: Born of snowdrift and silent sky, the Arctic Prowler blends the might of a polar bear with the piercing gaze and silent grace of an owl. Towering and winged, it moves with unsettling speed for its size, capable of both ground-bound ferocity and gliding precision. Despite its fearsome form, the Prowler is remarkably intelligent and surprisingly calm under a skilled rider. It learns quickly and bonds deeply, forming lifelong partnerships with those who show respect. In the frozen wilds, few companions are as loyal, or as lethal.

6064633895687159855.title: Mount Cosmetic: Ramstrider
6064633895687159855.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Broad-shouldered and boulder-hooved, the Ramstrider is a steadfast companion on even the roughest mountain paths. Its curled horns are as useful for defense as they are for show, and its thick coat shields both mount and rider from harsh weather. Those who favor dependability over speed often find no better partner than this surefooted beast.

6064633895706689595.title: Cosmetic: Blacksight Watcher

6064633895723597895.title: Cosmetic: Bog Brute

6064633895728644169.title: Mount Cosmetic: Wisp Whelk
6064633895728644169.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Gliding slowly beneath a crystalline shell, the Wisp Whelk is a mount like no other. Said to be part spirit and part creature, it leaves glowing trails wherever it passes. Though it travels at a patient pace, many believe its presence alters the very air around it, humming with soft, unseen energy. Those who ride it speak of dreams filled with starlight and calm.

6064633895769997404.title: Cosmetic: RainrockFawn
6064633895769997404.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895810760822.title: Cosmetic: Flash Hound

6064633895824064639.title: Mount Cosmetic: Veshan Komodo
6064633895824064639.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Scaled like sunbaked stone and simmering with desert heat, the Veshan Komodo prowls the burning sands of Verra with a relentless stride. As a mount, it endures scorching terrain and long journeys with tireless resolve. Those who ride it often speak of its hypnotic glare and the quiet, ominous hiss that accompanies its every breath.

6064633895841759371.title: Mount Cosmetic: Bloomfest Lancer
6064633895841759371.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Once bred by the famed Order of the Steel Bloom, these majestic steeds were trained for both battlefield charges and grand ceremonial displays. Adorned in elaborate floral trappings, they cut a striking figure whether trampling foes or leading a festival procession. Though the Order?s citadel lies quiet now, its knights scattered or long buried, the legacy of their mounts endures. To ride a Bloomfest Lancer is to carry the memory of noble vows, faded glory, and the last gasps of light before the darkness fell.

6064633900612255817.title: Deepweld Tidecut Rapier
6064633900612255817.description: A cool marine glimmer runs the ridge at motion, as if the blade kept the memory of running surf.

6064633900612583498.title: Dreadwake Veilpoint Rapier
6064633900612583498.description: The edge shows only a thin ghost of light before it slips back into gloom.

6064633900613894222.title: Glassveil Sunshard Rapier
6064633900613894222.description: A pale heat light threads the blade's centerline, brightening in open sky.

6064633900614156367.title: Glorybound Laurelpoint Rapier
6064633900614156367.description: A fine wreath etch crowns the quillon, quiet proof of pride that does not boast.

6064633900617105498.title: Shadowfang Murkpoint Rapier
6064633900617105498.description: Only the briefest spark marks the tip before it is gone to shade again.

6064633900618023005.title: Stormcurrent Squallpoint Rapier
6064633900618023005.description: Whorled striations catch and release light in quick, weather bright flashes.

6064633900618350686.title: Sunfire Dawnline Rapier
6064633900618350686.description: A soft morning hue rests along the ridge, gentle and sure as first light on stone.

6064633900620185701.title: Wavecutter Breakline Rapier
6064633900620185701.description: Fine ribs along the spine echo seawalls, and a cool brine sheen follows the motion.

6064633900653346935.title: Runeweld Sigilhammer
6064633900653346935.description: The Runeweld Sigilhammer pulses faintly in time with the wielder's breath, but skips a beat when spells are near. Marks pressed into stone by its head fade by morning, but never fully vanish.

6064633900656361597.title: Stoneforge Oathbreaker
6064633900656361597.description: The Stoneforge Oathbreaker leaves no mark on stone, but cracks shields with eerie precision. It grows heavier near liars, or so the old keepers claim.

6064633900657541248.title: Sunscorch Emberglass Great Mace
6064633900657541248.description: Glassy warmth pools beneath the surface and settles without glare.

6064633900677922951.title: Ashbrand Ember-Spear
6064633900677922951.description: Its point holds the breath of smoldering caverns, where ash drifts like snow through halls never rebuilt.

6064633900688933014.title: Nightreaver Moonfang Spear
6064633900688933014.description: The metal takes on a pale gleam, as if it has drunk from cold lunar light.

6064633900692209818.title: Sandcarved Djinn-Touched Spear
6064633900692209818.description: Balanced between mirage and truth, it moves as if guided by unseen breath from the deep places of the dunes.

6064633900707086513.title: Coralblade Maelstrom Greatsword
6064633900707086513.description: Born from a roaring vortex, this sword thrums with maelstrom echoes and carries the storm-wrought songs of the deep.

6064633900729696450.title: Deepweld Hollowforge Wand
6064633900729696450.description: A dim light glows within its core, as if something waits inside. The air hums faintly when it is lifted.

6064633900737298627.title: Dreadwake Gloam Great Grimoire
6064633900737298627.description: Densely woven binding swallows glare, the mass quiet in the hand the way a sealed crypt is quiet.

6064633900796215523.title: Ironhearth Grimoire
6064633900796215523.description: The Ironhearth Grimoire grows heavier the longer it is held open, as if resisting the knowledge it contains. When read aloud, the voice of the speaker sometimes echoes back with a cadence not their own.

6064633900801261802.title: Ironhearth Forgebrand Wand
6064633900801261802.description: The Ironhearth Forgebrand Wand glows with a slow ember-red pulse when buried power is near. Sparks trail behind its gestures, and heat lingers in the air long after its casting ends.

6064633900806439147.title: Mirageborn Hazeheld Great Grimoire
6064633900806439147.description: Boards resist warping in dry wind, and the signatures lie flat as desert night.

6064633900806766828.title: Mirageborn Sunwrought Twin Daggers
6064633900806766828.description: A soft blur trails the bevels in motion, a desert trick of light that settles at rest.

6064633900869288204.title: Pyrebrand Stonegrip Twin Daggers
6064633900869288204.description: A fine ember thread glows beneath the polish, steady as breath in a resting forge.

6064633900877676823.title: Runeweld Whisperbow
6064633900877676823.description: The Runeweld Whisperbow looses arrows without a sound and leaves faint script trailing behind the shaft. Its limbs flex subtly in the presence of unspoken names.

6064633900887507231.title: Sandcarved Djinn-Touched Shortbow
6064633900887507231.description: Veiled in a shimmer that moves without wind, this bow draws upon whispers buried in glass and fire.

6064633900926632257.title: Stoneforge Linecaster
6064633900926632257.description: The Stoneforge Linecaster aligns with intent, its string drawing straight as thought. Arrows from it trace invisible geometry and strike where purpose meets precision.

6064633900927615300.title: Stoneforge Gravemark Wand
6064633900927615300.description: The Stoneforge Gravemark Wand hums low when held over buried things and carves thin lines in dust without touch. Its spells strike true, as if guided by weight and memory alike.

6064633900933906757.title: Stormcurrent Galeheld Great Grimoire
6064633900933906757.description: Cartographer blues thread the capitals, and the spine rides open as neatly as a hull on calm water.

6064633901007634765.title: Sunscorch Noonbound Great Grimoire
6064633901007634765.description: Palm warm boards flex like air above heated stone, yet the leaves lie obedient and true.

6064633901007896910.title: Sunscorch Sunwrought Twin Daggers
6064633901007896910.description: The surface holds a glassy glow that shifts warm beneath desert sun.

6064633901009928532.title: Sunscorch Dawnflare Wand
6064633901009928532.description: Golden motes drift from its movements, fading quickly. Even darkness steps back from its light.

6064634489923371011.title: Divination's Remnant
6064634489923371011.description: This sceptre appears partially dissolved, its upper crest suspended in slow, spiraling motion above the haft. Etched along the length of its body are timeworn markings - some forward, some backward - all unfinished. When held, it feels both too heavy and too light, as if caught between two forgotten moments. It carries no crown, only a void where insight once lived. What remains is not prophecy, but aftermath.

6064634518642163804.title: Vestment of the Drowned Oath
6064634518642163804.description: This garment clings as though wet, despite never touching water. Its folds shimmer faintly with layered patterns that seem to ripple when not observed. Across the breast is an incomplete sigil, fractured at its center, as though its meaning was lost mid-oath. Where the fabric meets flesh, it draws tight. Not to protect, but to remind. It is not armor in the traditional sense. It is a second skin woven from promises left to rot beneath the tide.

6064634518652190828.title: Veilhood of the Parched Eclipse
6064634518652190828.description: This headpiece fits as though it was always worn, even before the hand reached for it. The outer layer carries a fine, dusted pattern like wind-carved script, unreadable but rhythmic. Beneath the surface, faint outlines shift in the shape of vanished stars, blinking out one by one. It gives the impression of shadow where there is none, and weight where there should be light.

6064634518665560192.title: Carapace of the Still Dune
6064634518665560192.description: The structure is thick, immobile, sun-scoured, and strangely silent. Not a sound echoes within it, not even breath. Across its surface are ridged patterns resembling petrified waves, their motion halted long before memory. The inside bears ancient stress lines, as if it once resisted great force, and perhaps still does. It's been said that the chestplate anchors itself to time itself, refusing to move forward until something long forgotten is named.
